summary: JBT Marel Corp filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $200 million of its common stock, effective June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2029. The company also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable June 9, 2026 to holders of record May 26, 2026. Repurchases are discretionary as to manner, timing, price, and volume, subject to market conditions and securities laws. Purchased shares will be held as treasury stock. The program may be modified, suspended, or discontinued at any time. Watch for actual buyback execution pace and any changes to the dividend policy.
